@[reducible] def Equation35685 (G : Type _) [Magma G] : Prop := ∀ (x y z : G), x = ((y ◇ (x ◇ z)) ◇ (y ◇ x)) ◇ y

theorem finite_trivial_dual (G : Type*) [Magma G] [Finite G] (h : Equation35685 G) : Equation2 G := by
  let opposite : Magma G := ⟨fun x y => y ◇ x⟩
  have hd : @ Equation10218 G opposite := by
    intro x y z
    exact h x y z
  exact @ finite_trivial G opposite inferInstance hd

end submission
